noCodes: Syracuse publishes no building-code list: the registrar's Class and Classroom Scheduling pages (registrar.syr.edu/faculty-staff/class-and-room-scheduling/, time-blocks/, policy/) list none, and the official interactive campus map (maps.syracuse.edu, linked from syracuse.edu/map/) gives building names (checked 2026-11-07).

excludeHalls.skyhalls: South Campus (Skyhall I–III on Lambreth Lane), about 2 km from Main Campus and linked by SU's South Campus buses; walks from it to Main Campus teaching buildings such as Whitman and Newhouse run past 45 minutes, and keeping it dropped those buildings for every hall (housingmealplans.syr.edu/residential-facilities/residence-halls/ lists it under South Campus).
